report.summary: Patient P-D002 (age 46, Medicaid/Lakeshore Community Health Plan, transport benefit: yes) needs community-resource options for utilities and transport. Utilities: shutoff-prevention clinic (walk-in Tuesdays for disconnection notices), income-based energy help (apply in person Mon/Wed), and a medical-certificate request form for utility shutoff protection (responds within one business day). Transport: Medicaid non-emergency ride line (patient is a Medicaid plan member, eligible; call at least 2 business days ahead); senior shuttle is not eligible (age 60+ required); ADA paratransit is an option if the patient qualifies and applies (decisions up to 21 days).
